answer: Someone running 166 aliases thus needs 196 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are entered in atlas, expire in spiral, and saffron lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 12 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4760 identities would post 1421 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
